proves.claim: With the setting naming a toolchain, a job goes only to the runner whose recorded toolchains include every named one.

cli.journeys-runner-runners-toolchains.w.why: Without it, a regression where this no longer holds would pass unnoticed: with the setting naming a toolchain, a job goes only to the runner whose recorded toolchains include every named one.

proves.claim: With the setting blank or unset every compatible runner is still eligible.
